title: The demo check holds a build to its own work and the build path holds on a busy host: real links, void tags, pasted comments, minified values and the template's own contrast are not the build's faults; a date is no phone; the look is charged as the ledger allows; an EmDash list keeps its rows; a claim asked again reserves its folder
steps: S1: compareAgentInventory over a JA module whose # link becomes the business's page, whose is saved as , whose pasted comment is gone; then one with an added paragraph.
S2: checkContrastReadable on the template's unreadable header text with its colours unchanged, and with a new colour pair, against the baseline that read it.
S4: checkLookKept after a minifier rewrote rgba(33, 37, 41, 0.5) as rgba(33,37,41,.5) and #fff as #FFFFFF.
S5: createDemoLook charged through the real cost ledger.
S6: mergeListPatches with a team list sent whole without _rowId, one row more than stored.
S7: POST /api/sites/claim asked twice for one build.
expect: S1: structure kept; the added paragraph changes it.
S5: the ledger accepts the charge (no account-cap refusal).
S6: the two stored rows keep their _rowId by position, the third stays new.
S7: the second claim reserves the site's folder on the host again.
fence: pictureValues' links, comments and void tags; checkContrastReadable's baseline; factsIn's dates

tests: a link made real, a pasted comment gone and a void tag closed another way keep the structure
contrast-readable and no-text-overlap: white on white fails, text over a picture is not judged
facts-from-brief: hours, prices, phones and a founding year the brief holds are shown as held
look-kept: the look Tracy handed over is held
the real cost ledger accepts the look's charge
a list field sent as the items that change is merged onto the list as the read answered it
POST /api/sites/claim: the name makes the site, its seat and its folder
